brief:
Canada has pledged 100 million Canadian dollars ($71 million) in aid for Palestinians, Al Jazeera English reported. The commitment comes as the United Kingdom and France have called for action against Israeli settlements during proceedings at the United Nations General Assembly.

The three countries' moves signal growing pressure on Israel's settlement expansion policies within international forums. Details on the allocation and timeline of Canada's aid package remain unclear from the available reporting.
dek: France's Macron says suffering in Gaza should 'shame all of us' as Canada's Carney pledges $71m for two-state efforts.
title: Canada pledges $71 million for Palestinians as allies demand settlement action
